de_bai:

A. $\log_{2\cdot 3}(3^{2}\cdot 5)=\dfrac{a \left(2 b + 1\right)}{b \left(a + 1\right)}$.
B. $\log_{2\cdot 3}(3^{2}\cdot 5)=- \dfrac{a \left(2 b + 1\right)}{b \left(a + 1\right)}$.
C. $\log_{2\cdot 3}(3^{2}\cdot 5)=\dfrac{a \left(2 b + 1\right)}{b \left(a + 1\right)} + 1$.
D. $\log_{2\cdot 3}(3^{2}\cdot 5)=\dfrac{a \left(2 b + 1\right)}{b \left(a + 1\right)} - 1$.
